texts.text: 21 screens designed in Arabic-first RTL; five are still
placeholders; the mobile end-to-end test suite is not yet in
place. Preparing for store release — not yet in stores.
The design and code are archived in the source repository. The
slots below render labelled placeholders — no customer-app capture is
published with this case study. A real capture pass is planned for the next
Five public screens show the network, the reward catalogue and a persistent sign-up prompt before login. Discovery is intentionally not gated.
Three registration screens cover consent, name and OTP verification. The interim email-port is designed, not implemented.
Two login flows plus the rotating QR screen — single-use, signed, expired on first scan.
Authenticated surfaces: home, my vouchers, voucher reveal and redeem confirm. Idempotent on retry.
Submission posts to the API with an Idempotency-Key; internal notes never appear in the customer-facing resolution field.
21 screens in 4 groups (Public 5, Registration 3, Login 2, Authenticated 11) catalogued in the design spec. Arabic-first with RTL; Latin
digits for points and countdowns. Five screens — My QR, Redeem Confirm interstitial, Voucher Reveal, My Vouchers and History —
Store release is gated on a short list of work the platform does not do today. Each item is a deliberate follow-up rather than an
Store submission (Google Play, App Store) — blocked on a production signing key.
OTP delivery adapter — the interim email-port is designed, not implemented.
Account deletion — absent today across API, app and website.
Privacy Policy text and in-app Terms — placeholders remain for the legal entity.
iOS bundle configuration — no current-Xcode archive yet.
